messages:
marco: Heads up — we're seeing a spike of 502s from edge-auth on eu-west1 affecting embeddings traffic. Rolling patch ready, but need expedited approvals to bypass canary window.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] requested: deploy edge-auth@v2.3.14 -> started approval flow. Canary default is 15m.

tasha: Can we pin the canary to 10% and shorten to 5m? Severity is high for customer-facing inference paths. cc @dave

jen: We need two infra approvals to skip full canary. I'm granting one if SLO rollback checks are in.

marco: Rollback criteria: error rate back to <=0.5% of baseline OR tail latency >2x for 3 consecutive mins triggers immediate rollback.

dave: I approve skip to expedited canary. I also want autoscaler on standby, monitoring hook added.

ops-oncall: Second approval from ops. We're oncall, will watch logs and be ready to cut traffic. :eyes:

marco: Deploy command (run by release lead):
```
/deploy run --service=edge-auth --image=redwood/edge-auth:v2.3.14 --region=eu-west1 --canary=10% --canary-duration=5m --pin=true
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] approval count: 2/2. Scheduling canary window now. Starting canary instances (4 replicas).

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary progress: 60s elapsed — error-rate down 40% vs previous, no spike observed.

tasha: Monitoring traces — prefix cache warm, KV hits steady. Sending note to CS that we'll be rolling forward if stable.

marco: OK to roll forward after 5m if metrics hold. If anything looks odd, ops will call rollback.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary completed (5m). Metrics within thresholds. Initiating gradual cutover to 100% over 2m.

ops-oncall: Cutover in progress. Watching logs. Will post if we see >0.5% spike.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] deployment successful. edge-auth@v2.3.14 now primary in eu-west1. Release note stub: "Fix edge-auth race causing occasional 502s on short-lived streams; improves KV cache warming during cold starts."

jen: Adding to release notes and tagging in the changelog. Thanks for the quick approvals and monitoring team. :thumbsup:

marco: Postmortem follow-up: we'll add a short test for the race in CI and set a lower canary default for edge services.

ops-oncall: ACK — closing the expedited approval thread.
